chapter.heading: The Altar of Incense
chapter.v:
“Make from
acacia wood an altar for burning incense.

It shall
be square, measuring a cubit by a cubit, by two cubits high, with horns on its corners that are all one piece with the altar.

Cover its
top, its side, and its horns with pure gold, and make a gold trim to go all around it.

On two
of the altar's sides make two gold rings and attach them below the trim to hold the poles that carry it.

Make the
poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.

Put the
altar in front of the veil that hangs before the Ark of the Testimony and the atonement cover that is over the Testimony where I will meet with you.

Aaron is
to burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he takes care of the lamps.

When he
lights the lamps in the evening he must burn incense again so that incense will always be burned in the Lord's presence for generations to come.

Don't offer
on this altar any unapproved incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour out a drink offering upon it.

Once a
year Aaron must perform the atonement ritual by placing blood on the horns of the altar from the sin offering for atonement. This yearly atonement ritual must be carried out for generations to come. This is the Lord's holy altar.”
chapter.heading: The Atonement-Tax
chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses,

“When you
take a census of the Israelites, each man must pay the Lord to buy back his life when he's counted. Then they won't suffer from the plague when they're counted.

Each one
who crosses over to those counted must give a half shekel (using the sanctuary shekel standard, which weighs twenty gerahs). This half shekel is an offering to the Lord.

This offering
to the Lord is required from everyone twenty years old and more.

When you
give this offering to buy back your lives the rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less.

Take this
money paid by the Israelites and use it for the expenses involved in the services of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a reminder for the Israelites to buy back your lives in the presence of the Lord.”
chapter.heading: The Washbasin
chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses,

“Make a
bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Place it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

Aaron and
his sons will use it to wash their hands and feet.

Whenever they
enter the Tent of Meeting, they are to wash with water so that they will not die. When they approach the altar to present burnt offerings to the Lord,

they must
also wash so that they will not die. This requirement is to be observed by them and their descendants for all generations.”
chapter.heading: Holy Anointing Oil
chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses,

“Take the
best quality spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, 250 shekels of sweet-smelling cinnamon, 250 shekels of aromatic reed,

500 shekels
of cassia (weights using the sanctuary shekel standard), and a hin of olive oil.

Mix these
together into holy anointing oil, an aromatic blend like the product of an expert perfumer. Use it as holy anointing oil.

Use it
to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the Ark of the Testimony,

the table
and all its equipment, the lampstand and its equipment, the altar of incense,

the altar
of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin plus its stand.

Dedicate them
so that they will be especially holy. Whatever touches them will become holy.

Anoint Aaron
and his sons too and dedicate them to serve as priests for me.

Tell the
Israelites, ‘This is to be my holy anointing oil for all generations to come.

Don't use
it on ordinary people and don't make anything like it using the same formula. It is holy, and you must treat it as being holy.

Anyone who
mixes anointing oil like it, or puts it on someone other than a priest, will be expelled from their people.’”
chapter.heading: Holy Incense
chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses, “Take equal amounts of these aromatic spices: balsam resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense.

Add some
salt and make pure and holy incense blended like the product of an expert perfumer.

Grind some
of it into powder and place it in front of the Ark of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be especially holy to you.

Don't make
for yourselves any incense like it using the same formula. You are to consider this incense as holy to the Lord.

Anyone who
makes incense like this for themselves to enjoy will be expelled from their people.”
